top_signals.title: Passkey-themed phishing attacks lead to Microsoft 365 data theft
top_signals.summary: Microsoft says threat actors linked to ShinyHunters, Helix, and other extortion gangs are using passkey and single sign-on-themed social engineering attacks to compromise corporate Microsoft accounts and steal data from Microsoft 365 services. [...]
